name: Waxeggalm
kurzbeschreibung: Alpine and mountain cuisine at 1,880 m in the Zemmgrund near Ginzling, with homemade cakes and Austrian dishes by the innkeepers Ottilie and Alfred.
beschreibung: The Waxeggalm is situated at around 1,880 metres above sea level in the idyllic Zemmgrund, a side valley of the rear Zillertal near Ginzling. It is one of the alpine and mountain catering establishments and is a popular destination for hikers travelling on trail no. 523 towards the Berliner Hütte or along the glacier trail. Surrounding three-thousand-metre peaks and the glaciers of the Zillertal Alps High Mountain Nature Park shape the panorama. According to the tourism board, the innkeepers Ottilie and Alfred serve homemade cakes and dishes from Austrian cuisine and welcome their guests in person. The alm can be reached on foot through the Zemmgrund, among others via the Grawandhütte and the Alpenrosenhütte.
